name: RC-B10-0110/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran's government to stop its repression: it wants all political prisoners freed, the death penalty abolished, and violence against protesters ended. It asks European Union countries to add more sanctions, such as asset freezes and travel bans, on officials responsible for abuses. It also wants independent United Nations documentation of atrocities for future prosecutions, and help for people at serious risk. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Parliament urges the Council and member states to expand sanctions on Iranian officials; no decision is made yet.
- It demands Iran release all arbitrarily detained people, including foreign and dual nationals.
- It calls for United Nations documentation of abuses and possible referral to the International Criminal Court.
